Class List<E>

java.lang.Object
util.List<E>
Type Parameters:
E - the type of the objects in the list.
All Implemented Interfaces:
Iterable<E>
Direct Known Subclasses:
DeckList, VehicleList
public class List<E> extends Object implements Iterable<E>
Generic class that is a resizable array implementation of a list. The initial capacity is 4, and it grows by 4 whenever the array is full. The list can be traversed with a for-each loop.
